_comment: Answer key for the cold-agent documentation benchmark whose questions and
method live in Reports/documentation-audit.md. It is HERE, outside Reports/,
because the benchmark prompt restricts the agent under test to README.md,
CLAUDE.md, PLAN.md, PLAN-log.md, wiki/ and Reports/ -- so .claude/ is out of
bounds by the instrument's own rule rather than by a new one.
Do not move this back into Reports/, and do not paste it into a runner.
Grading a run: compare files_opened, source_files_read and traps_refused.

runs.agent_closing_observation: The index files in this repo are unusually load-bearing and worth reading first in any future session.

per_question.Q1: Named src/sim/load.rs, distinguished it from structural.rs (which only orders the support forest by anchor distance), and produced a prioritised reading list from the index alone -- including the then-in-flight load-concentration-review-response.md on the unmerged load-share branch with its hash, i.e. coordinate rather than duplicate.
per_question.Q2: Found the reversal in dead-ends.md, quoted the ~5x cell-count ballooning and the vertical-first 1%-compress throttle as the mechanism, gave the re-test condition, and flagged the adjacent near-miss entry (the landed horizontal-first move whose Cell::flowing() gating was rejected) as a distinct case -- which is what separates a good index from a lucky grep.
per_question.Q3: Routed to the implementation plan's inline per-phase status, then PLAN.md, then the index's in-flight section. REFUSED THE TRAP: Reports/load-model-handoff.md is not safe to execute, for two independent reasons found separately -- the index marks it superseded by landing (7e13e42), and its section 3 instruction (a stored per-cell support parent in a side table on World) is a recorded dead end whose entry ends 'Do not add the table back.'

runs.why_q3_is_the_point: Before the overhaul, CLAUDE.md's knowledge table advertised that same document as 'The next step on destruction, written up to be picked up cold.' A cold agent following the old table would have executed a superseded work order whose central instruction is a dead end -- the exact wasted session the overhaul exists to prevent.

runs.tree: e20e338 plus the agent-consumption audit branch
runs.notes: Routing improved across 258 commits and ~14 new reports since the overhaul. Found a third reason to refuse the trap that the baseline run did not report: load-model-handoff.md's own header still reads 'Status: not started', which the index contradicts. This run also flagged, unprompted, that the answer key was then inside Reports/ and made the benchmark non-blind -- which is why the key now lives here.
